title: KestrelCare Repair Sales Tax Rates by Registration State
content:
| Registration state on the vehicle's purchase order | Repair sales tax rate on a KestrelCare remainder authorization |
|---|---|
| Arizona | 5.6 percent (0.056) |
| Texas | 6.25 percent (0.0625) |
| any other state | none |

**Rule.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization, repair sales tax is added at the rate for the state in which the vehicle is registered on its Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order: the Arizona repair tax rate for a vehicle registered in Arizona, the Texas repair tax rate for a vehicle registered in Texas, and no repair sales tax for a vehicle registered in any other state.

The tax is added to the amount payable after the plan deductible has been taken, by multiplying that amount by one plus the rate, and it is added last; the per-visit limit and the coverage remaining are compared with the figure after the tax.

*Hypothetical figures:* an amount of 1500.00 becomes 1584.00 for a vehicle registered in Arizona and 1593.75 for one registered in Texas; for a vehicle registered in Colorado it stays 1500.00. If the per-visit limit were 1550.00, the Arizona and Texas figures would each be held to 1550.00.
